title: The Adventures of Augie March
author: Saul Bellow
summary: Augie March, a poor Chicago boy during the Depression, tells his own story, drifting through jobs, mentors and schemes while refusing every fixed idea of who he should be.
readIf: you like exuberant, dense prose and a big, wandering coming-of-age tale.
skipIf: you want brisk storytelling and a tight, linear plot.
